caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of an intricately carved architectural ornament, resembling the volute of an Ionic capital. The object is primarily colored in shades of gold and ochre, with nuanced variations to indicate light, shadow, and depth, and features black shadows and recessed areas to emphasize its three-dimensional form. The ornament includes a prominent central spiral, concentric ridges, small decorative details, and stylized acanthus leaf motifs extending from the sides. The background is plain and off-white, ensuring that the ornate object is the sole focus of the composition.
title: Billethead
